svg.title: AlphaChess Capability Progress
svg.desc: Simple line chart of AlphaChess capability over real timestamps, similar to an AlphaGo rating-over-time graph. The y axis is a conservative direct Stockfish score-rate proxy: score divided by max(games, 4), with the best value seen so far plotted over time. Data points include 2026-05-18T09:14:04-07:00 0.0/2 at 0 percent, 2026-05-18T13:18:35-07:00 0.0/2 at 0 percent, 2026-05-18T16:03:41-07:00 0.5/2 at 12.5 percent, 2026-05-18T23:13:16-07:00 0.5/1 at 12.5 percent after conservative scaling, 2026-05-19T00:04:01-07:00 0.5/1 at 12.5 percent after conservative scaling, 2026-05-19T10:31:47-07:00 0.5/4 at 12.5 percent, 2026-05-19T13:57:45-07:00 0.5/2 at 12.5 percent after conservative scaling, 2026-05-19T18:01:50-07:00 0.5/2 at 12.5 percent after conservative scaling, 2026-05-19T18:48:42-07:00 0.0/2 at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T19:11:04-07:00 0.0/2 guarded check at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T19:34:49-07:00 broad65k gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T19:56:50-07:00 expert-mix gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T20:49:36-07:00 fullnet192 puzzle-mix gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T21:22:07-07:00 fullnet192 CPU loss-overfit gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T21:50:00-07:00 fullnet192 holdout-selected gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T22:01:55-07:00 fullnet192 latest-loss repair gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T22:07:00-07:00 strict root-guard gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T22:33:45-07:00 higher-time teacher gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T23:13:05-07:00 broad/t05 hard-negative gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T23:33:20-07:00 top-3 hard-negative gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-19T23:49:30-07:00 opening/ELO2000/tactical gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T00:22:48-07:00 Stockfish-confirmed model-blunder gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T00:40:04-07:00 full-network confirmed-blunder gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T00:45:14-07:00 bad-margin full-network confirmed-blunder gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T00:58:51-07:00 broad73k full-network confirmed-blunder gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T01:03:44-07:00 exact bad-action book parent gate at 0 percent, 2026-05-20T01:04:09-07:00 exact bad-action book full-network gate at 0 percent, and 2026-05-20T01:07:29-07:00 exact bad-action book plus strict root guards gate at 0 percent. The 50 percent line marks the local Stockfish promotion gate.
svg.text: Best conservative direct-Stockfish score rate: score / max(games, 4). Not calibrated Elo.
